name: browserai-payload
description: The vendored @playwright/mcp payload. Never published; this file exists only so the payload build has something to resolve.
//: THIS IS THE FLOAT, NOT A PIN. `latest` is the npm dist-tag, re-resolved from
an empty node_modules on every payload build. package-lock.json beside this
file records what it resolved to and is a provenance stamp, never a target:
build/Build-Payload.ps1 deletes the lock before installing, so nothing here
playwright-core is deliberately NOT declared here. It arrives as
@playwright/mcp's own exact dependency, and upstream publishes daily alphas:
on 2026-08-15 npm `latest` for playwright-core was 1.62.1 while the version
that actually ships was 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05. Declaring it would create a
second, independently floating source for a version upstream pins exactly.
See CLAUDE.md, 'Versioning: everything floats, the build freezes it'.
